repos_data.description: ⚓ Terminal UI (TUI) for Docker Compose — manage containers, view logs, exec, monitor CPU/RAM.
A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
DLIA is an AI-powered Docker log monitoring agent that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to intelligently analyze container logs, detect anomalies, and provide contextual insights over time.
User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
An open source trusted cloud native registry project that stores, signs, and scans content.
⚓ A friendly CLI to manage multiple Docker Compose deployments with style — powered by Typer, Rich, questionary, and sh.

Kubernetes operator for self-hosted LLM inference across a heterogeneous GPU fleet: NVIDIA CUDA, AMD Vulkan, and Apple Silicon Metal. Runtimes: llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, mlx-server. Multi-GPU sharding, model caching, OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Apache-2.0, run across homelab and on-prem fleets, actively developed.
A curated collection of ready-to-use Docker Compose files for local web development, plus a powerful CLI (dctl) to manage and orchestrate your registered stacks from anywhere in your terminal.

Accelerate local LLM inference and finetuning (LLaMA, Mistral, ChatGLM, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Gemma, Phi, MiniCPM, Qwen-VL, MiniCPM-V, etc.) on Intel XPU (e.g., local PC with iGPU and NPU, discrete GPU such as Arc, Flex and Max); seamlessly integrate with llama.cpp, Ollama, HuggingFace, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, DeepSpeed, Axolotl, etc.

This is a One-Click docker images and containers setup base which is doing via a lot of bash scripts. My primary target is embedded linux development and you can choose your target whatever you want. Have fun. Thank you for your starts.
Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.

repo_meta_data.description: Stop configuring your AI stack. Start using it. One command brings a complete pre-wired LLM stack with hundreds of services to explore.
